quests.title: Breezy Snapshots

dialogue.sit: What event have you got going on here?

dialogue.t: An event? No, no, I have neither the energy nor ability for something like that.
I'm merely someone interested in photo-taking. I even had someone get me a Kamera and took a great many pictures with it.
The people at the Guild seemed to really like the pictures I took. Cyrus even said that we could turn them into books and give them out as souvenirs.
And well, you know what? Since it's Windblume Festival, Cyrus requested that I go around Mondstadt and take various pictures related to the festival.
He's planning on putting them together into a commemorative album to be given out to the adventurers in the Guild as mementos.
But... Mondstadt's a big place with lots of photo-taking spots, and I'm just one person...
The other adventurers are also out on their own errands and won't have any time to help.
I know that a festival isn't really the right time to be asking around for help... but please, Traveler! I've heard that you're a dab hand at the Kamera, so please, help me out!

dialogue.sit: Well, I do know a thing or two...
Where'd you hear that about me?

dialogue.t: Phew, alright, that's a relief. So the rumors are true then...
Anyway, Traveler, in that case, allow me to formally request your help in going around Mondstadt to take pictures using your Kamera.
Ah, yes, why don't you use this Kamera to take your photos? I maintain it regularly, so it runs very smoothly.
I mean, it takes a good Kamera to take good pictures, wouldn't you say?
I'll be counting on you, then. The pictures just need to be related to the Windblume Festival. Otherwise, there are no particular restrictions on their content!
As for the reward, you don't need to worry. I'll follow the usual Guild regulations. You won't be working for free!
Now, I'll need to sort the pictures here into categories...

quests.description: Fassben of the Adventurers’ Guild seems to be busy with something…
